text: This code is a correct implementation of the factorial function using recursion. It takes an integer n as input and returns its factorial. The base case is handled by checking if n is 0, in which case the function returns 1, as defined by the problem statement. For any other value of n, the function calls itself with the argument n-1, effectively multiplying the result by n. This recursive approach is a straightforward and efficient way to calculate the factorial of a given number. The code is well-structured and easy to follow, making it a suitable solution for the task.
